cohort: 308 mothers (170 completed the survey) who had either a term breech or vertex delivery
finding: The birth experience does not differ significantly between vaginal breech and vertex births, with some indications of an even more positive experience in the breech group (except for analgesia choice).
mod_finding: The study found that the birth experience for women who had a vaginal breech birth was similar to the experience of women who had a vaginal vertex birth.
